messages:
Sam: starting canary v2.8.1 to us-east (change window)  initial traffic 5% across embeddings and rerank. deploy-bot: rollout 6999 started at 1769999988 -> https://deploys.redwood/6999

Lina: watching embeddings p95 + 5xx. Marcus pls watch rerank p99 in us-east.

Marcus: rerank p99 jumped from 280ms -> 610ms and 5xx rose to 0.7% (threshold 0.4%). Link: https://console.redwood/slo/rerank-route/us-east

SLO-alert-bot: [ALERT] rerank-route (us-east) p99 > 500ms (610ms)  severity=critical

Sam: logs show model-serve worker timeouts on host ms-us-09 around the spike. snippet: `2026-03-27T02:12:12Z error: rpc timeout to ms-us-09`

Lina: embeddings look okay. Given localized rerank signal, propose: PAUSE rerank canary in us-east and PIN rerank->v2.7.4 there. Avoid global rollback. Anyone object?

Marcus: no objections. Running `deployctl pause --rollout=6999 --route=rerank --region=us-east` and then pin.

deploy-bot: pause accepted at 1769999990. exec pin: `deployctl pin --route=rerank --region=us-east --version=v2.7.4 --reason='p99-spike-canary'` -> pin successful at 1769999994. rerank us-east traffic reverted.

Sam: good. Keep embeddings canary running. Lina, please add a short release-note line and file an incident for eng-runtime to gather rpc queues and host cpu.

release-notes-bot: PR updated https://git.redwood/release-notes/pulls/420 with note: "Pinned rerank in us-east to v2.7.4 during canary due to p99 spike; embeddings continue; eng-runtime investigating host rpc timeouts."

Marcus: collecting traces and queue histograms now, will post when available.

Sam: decision: hold rerank pin until eng-runtime validates a fix or we can re-run a small rerank-only canary. Re-open thread with updates. :thumbsup:
